title: allocarya muricata
intro: Allocarya muricata, commonly known as the "mouse ear" plant, is a type of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations, reduce oxidative stress, and combat infections. The therapeutic actions of Allocarya muricata are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exert antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Allocarya muricata include sesquiterpene lactones, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
